subject.title: fix(config): improve validation error messages with line numbers, bracket paths, and received values

question: Should terminal config errors show the effective value rejected after resolution, the literal source value, or no value when those differ?
rationale: The choice determines both diagnostic correctness and whether environment-resolved or plugin-defined values may cross into terminal output; repository behavior cannot safely define that disclosure policy by inference.

options.title: Effective value with provenance redaction
options.body: Show the actual rejected value only after sensitivity and secret provenance are checked across core, plugin, include, and environment-resolution paths.

options.title: Source literal with explicit wording
options.body: Keep raw-source lookup but label the hint as the configured source value so it does not claim to be the value validation received.

options.title: Defer received-value output
options.body: Land only line numbers and bracketed display paths, leaving value disclosure for a separately approved security design.

recommendation.title: Effective value with provenance redaction
recommendation.body: Show the actual rejected value only after sensitivity and secret provenance are checked across core, plugin, include, and environment-resolution paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config-validation and schema history makes steipete the strongest available routing candidate for this security-sensitive CLI contract.
